summary_for_children: Surah Qaf points to the sky with no cracks, the earth with mountains and plants, and rain that brings life, as signs that Allah can bring people back to life.
environment_concept: A sky without rifts (50:6), mountains and beautiful plants (50:7), blessed rain over grain (50:9) and lofty palms with layered fruit (50:10).
architecture_and_scenery: A seamless dome sky, wide plains, firm mountains, harvest fields, tall palm groves.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Earth Comes Alive
story_library.children_narration: Look at the sky, mountains, trees, and fields. The Quran asks us to think about the beauty and order of creation. Rain falls, and plants grow from land that was dry. These signs invite us to reflect on life, resurrection, and our responsibility for our choices.

world_idea.title: The Garden After Rain
world_idea.description: Explore an arid landscape that gradually grows plants after rainfall. Observe seed germination and discover Quran-linked reflection points.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
